context_notes: Integration-checker (agentId a09edfbe13abd6be8) ran 41/41 tests, confirmed all 4 phase-01 E2E flows wired, 0 blockers. Two new WARNINGs not previously tracked: (1) WR-01's '(no output)' branch is dead on the real success path because run_shell always returns stdout/stderr keys (even as '') on success -- loop.py's `elif 'stdout' in result or 'stderr' in result` is always true, so combined='' for no-output commands instead of '(no output)'. Fix: check truthiness (`result.get('stdout','') or result.get('stderr','')`) not key presence. (2) parsed['tool'] is parsed but never read -- run_shell called unconditionally for any type=='tool'. Harmless with Phase 1's single tool; needs name-based dispatch before Phase 3 file tools. Both fixes are small and isolated to loop.py -- good /gsd:quick candidates. SC6 is a pure empirical run (no code change), just execute olla --smoke-test --model <name> for each of: tripolskypetr/gemma4-uncensored-aggressive:latest, gemma4:e2b, goekdenizguelmez/JOSIEFIED-Qwen3:0.6b/1.7b/4b -- record think=False/True compliance % and any D-08 sub-80% warnings, then append results to 01-AUDIT.md (or a new SC6-RESULTS section).
